mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an easing monetary policy, which lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following a decline in FEDFUNDS are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 5.0%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic activity across supply and demand sectors, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in INDPRO and HOUST is followed by negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (high GDP growth and low unemployment), a rising CPIAUCSL signals impending monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, a rise in CPIAUCSL is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) reflects strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following an increase in RSAFS are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a deteriorating labor market and tightening monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in UNRATE and FEDFUNDS is followed by positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 6.0%), a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals a recovery in the housing sector, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 6.0%), a rise in HOUST is followed by negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
